description: Latvian company officers and directors from the official Uzņēmumu reģistrs open data (CC0, refreshed daily): board members, chairs, liquidators and other representatives with role, governing body, representation rights and registration date; corporate officers carry their own registration number, and an officer whose number is an individual merchant's is served as a natural person, without it. GDPR minimisation: never the Latvian personal identity number, birth year only when published, never the month. The answer carries the company's statut and statut_detail: an active company with no officer gets an empty list (a register fact); a struck-off company whose officers the register removed returns 404 radiee_inscriptions_retirees, not billed; one that keeps some is served under partial coverage. Legal persons only: an individual merchant (IK), a sole trader or a form not recognised as a legal person returns 404, not billed. Paid via x402 ($0.01 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.
